In summary, our research is concerned with
the preparation of Na5YSi4O12-type Na+ superionic conductors by glass-ceramic processing.
the development of a new type of glass-ceramic solid electrolyte with high conductivity and low activation energy.
the preparation and properties of glass-crystalline superionic conductors, which have a high conductivity and a low activation energy.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the N5YGe and N5YTe glass-ceramics are the most promising candidates for practical application in the Na 5 R Si 4 O 1 2 -type Na + superionic conductor.
the ionic conductivity of the glass ceramics is determined by the phase composition, grain size, grain boundaries and the microstructure of the glass-cermics.
the N5YGeSiO glass-ceramic is superior in the conductivity and activation energy to other N5YXSiO glass-cers.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the N5YGe and N5YTi systems are more suitable for the development of superionic conductors than the N5YTe system.
the N5YS glass-ceramic is a promising material for solid electrolyte applications.
the N5YTiS glass-ceramic with a large grain growth is most promising for practical use as a Na + -conductor.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the conductivity of N5YGeSiO glass-ceramic was 10 − 1  S/cm at room temperature, which was the highest value among the N5YSiO glass-ceramics.
the glass-ceramization of Na 3+ 3x Y 3 − x X y Si3 − y O 9 glasses with X elements (Ti, Ge, Te) is a promising method for obtaining the superionic conductors.

the glass-ceramization of the glass with the composition of Na 3+ 3 x Y 1 –  x X y S i 3 –  y O 8 (X = T i,  G e,  T e ) can be used as the method for producing superionic conductors of N 5 R S i 4 O 1 2 -type (R = rare earth; Y) in a wide range of the composition.
